title: Halverson Unified School District
summary: A mid-size school district (about 9,100 students, fourteen schools, 30 bus routes, cloud SIS with on-premises file shares, payroll and building automation) and a tabletop exercise generated from its simulated plans: ransomware with data-theft extortion during the state assessment window, followed by an emailed threat and a swatting call against a high school.
notice: Exercise material — for training use. The Halverson Unified School District, its schools, people, procedures, numbers, addresses and identifiers are simulated; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/k12-district/SOURCES.md.

scenarios.title: Digital Lockdown
scenarios.summary: On the second morning of the state assessment window, ransomware encrypts the district's on-premises servers after data was stolen from the student-services file share; the actor emails staff and parents with sample IEP and health records, an emailed threat and a swatting call put Halverson High School into lockdown, and the district must decide on containment, testing, closures, notices and the ransom demand.
